{{Quote|Another Padawan found a cave tunnel the Flesh Raiders use to enter this valley. I need you at that tunnel, making sure the Flesh Raiders don't get any more reinforcements through it.|[[Derrin Weller]] sends the apprentice to the cave|<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />}}
A '''cave tunnel''' connected the [[Tythos Ridge]] of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and the region known as the [[Tythonian Gnarls]] to the north on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The northern end of the tunnel was located on the cliffs on the southern side of the Gnarls, and members of the [[Flesh Raider]] [[Species/Legends|species]] had constructed several crude dwellings inside. During the [[Flesh Raider uprising|conflict]] between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Flesh Raiders<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Callef]] led an invasion force of Flesh Raiders through the [[Cave/Legends|cave]] against the [[Gnarls Outpost|Jedi outpost]] in the Gnarls, and the Flesh Raiders brought the captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Unaw Aharo]] to Callef in the cave. Before he could [[Death/Legends|execute]] Aharo, Callef was killed in a [[Duel in the Gnarls cave|duel]] with a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi apprentice]] sent to seal the cave, and the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]] collapsed the tunnel with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to prevent the Flesh Raiders from continuing their [[Attack on the Gnarls Outpost|attack]].<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gnarls cave first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a class-restricted phase for the Jedi Knight class mission "Attack of the Flesh Raiders" on Tython.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" />
